notes: Adds Windows PC recorder support: schedule from the app, then let your PC record to its local, USB or NAS folder while this device is off. Download the Windows recorder preview at greenstreemlabs.com. Includes short setup instructions, PC recording status and replay, a fixed guide clock/time header with clean scrolling edges, Update EPG now in the quick panel, held Back to TV Home, connected-TV channel retuning, and reconnect recovery for interrupted device recordings. One PC recording at a time; PC must stay on, signed in and running the recorder.
